description: Source code implementing a Content Decryption Module (CDM) interface for DRM systems, including classes for managing sessions, buffers, and system factories, with plugin loading and support checking.

classes.name: OCDMImplementation
classes.description: Main plugin class managing DRM system factories, sessions, and plugin loading.

classes.name: ExternalAccess
classes.description: RPC communicator for external access to the OCDM interface.

classes.name: AccessorOCDM
classes.description: Implements the OCDM::IAccessorOCDM interface, manages sessions and system factories.

classes.name: BufferAdministrator
classes.description: Manages buffer allocation and release for DRM sessions.

classes.name: SessionImplementation
classes.description: Represents a DRM session, manages session data, buffers, and callbacks.

classes.name: DataExchange
classes.description: Handles data exchange for DRM session buffers, runs in a separate thread.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Callback handler for session events such as key messages and status updates.

methods.name: TrimWs
methods.description: Trims whitespace from start and end of a string segment.

methods.name: Tokenize
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on a delimiter.

methods.name: ParseContentType
methods.description: Parses MIME type and codecs from a content type string.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the OCDM plugin, loads factories, and sets up the service.

methods.name: IsTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a key system and content type are supported.

methods.name: KeySystem
methods.description: Returns the media keys interface for a given key system.
